cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Bright Salesforce sky-blue (#00A1E0) glowing header: 'Salesforce-to-Salesforce Integration Architecture'. Subtitle in white: 'Org Connect, S2S patterns, identity, events, APIs, and governance at enterprise scale'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. THREE BRIGHT LAYERS with glowing rounded borders: TOP LAYER 'Source Orgs' vivid cyan/blue border — modules 'Sales Cloud NA', 'Service Cloud EU', 'Partner Org' as bright white pill badges with micro Salesforce cloud icons. MID LAYER 'Integration Control Plane' vivid purple border — modules 'Canonical Model', 'Idempotency Store', 'Retry Queue' as bright white pills. BOTTOM LAYER 'Target Orgs and Consumers' vivid teal/green border — modules 'Revenue Org', 'Support Org', 'Agentforce 2.0' as bright white pills. Central glowing node: 'Org Connect Router' in Salesforce sky-blue circle with lightning bolt icon, bright dotted connector arrows flowing to all layers. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'Composite API v64.0' and 'Platform Events / CDC'. BOTTOM STRIP teal background: 'Governed S2S Flow' → 'Map Identity' → 'Enforce Ownership' → 'Replay Safely' with flow arrows. Salesforce cloud watermark very subtle bottom-left. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
images: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Salesforce-to-Salesforce Sync Anti-Patterns'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Salesforce-to-Salesforce Sync Anti-Patterns'. Subtitle 'The failures I see before the API limit errors show up'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Record ID Coupling with broken chain icon', 'Trigger Fan-Out with explosion icon', 'No Replay Ledger with missing log icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD S2S SYNC' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD S2S SYNC' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: 'target.External_Id__c = source.Id; update target;'. right column green border '// GOOD' code: 'target.Global_Account_Key__c = source.Global_Account_Key__c; Database.upsert(target, Account.Global_Account_Key__c, AccessLevel.USER_MODE);'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Use business keys', 'Store correlation IDs', 'Replay from ledger'. Footer bar: 'Do not build distributed coupling with prettier API calls'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.

Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Secure Org-to-Org Callout Pattern'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Secure Org-to-Org Callout Pattern'. Subtitle 'Named Credentials, user-mode reads, and audited writes for Salesforce API v64.0'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Least Privilege Integration User with shield icon', 'Named Credential OAuth with key icon', 'Sync Ledger Audit with clipboard icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD SECURITY' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD SECURITY' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: 'Account a = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :id]; update a;'. right column green border '// GOOD' code: 'Account a = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :id WITH USER_MODE]; Database.update(a, AccessLevel.USER_MODE);'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'No personal admin tokens', 'Audit correlation IDs', 'Minimize replicated fields'. Footer bar: 'Replication expands your security boundary'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.
